negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, Ramen Ichiramen no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously, customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef, but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative.

I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise.

I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However, I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously, both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered, meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice.

In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available.

Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Ramen Ichiramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen.

One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.

negative_reviews.text:
I am writing about an incident at the Aberdeen branch on 12 October 2026 at approximately 20:10, while working as a part-time delivery driver.

When I arrived, only two or three tables were occupied, yet the servers were gathered near the bar and I had to wait around 8–10 minutes just to get someone’s attention. When a server finally approached, I told him the order was ready and likely on the collection shelf. He checked the bag, insisted it was not the correct order, and walked away without properly resolving the issue.

I tried to get another server’s attention, but he also initially ignored me. When he eventually came forward, he likewise claimed the bag was incorrect and appeared reluctant to check it properly. I had to insist that he verify the order number before he finally acknowledged that it was the correct bag.

What disappointed me most was not simply the wasted time, but the lack of assistance, communication and professionalism throughout the interaction. Having several years of management experience myself, I understand that mistakes happen, but staff should be willing to check an order properly rather than dismissing a delivery driver who is simply trying to do their job.

Delivery drivers’ time matters too, and we should not have to repeatedly chase staff for basic assistance or insist on a straightforward order-number check.

I strongly encourage the management team to review this incident, including any available CCTV and order records, and address the staff conduct and collection procedures at this branch.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that delivery drivers are treated with the courtesy and professionalism they deserve.

negative_reviews.author: Noth
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, restaurant no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative.

I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise.

I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice.

In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available.

Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Maki&Ramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen.

One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.

negative_reviews.author: ruby nottidge
negative_reviews.text: I’ve been here 3 times and every time I’ve been here, the service has been terrible. Really long wait times for drinks and food, ended up waiting even longer for the bill. There’s a man that waits on tables, he has his hair in a bun and is quite muscular (didn’t catch his name) he was very rude, and gave us lip when we asked for chilli oil (that I’d already ordered), he went to bring out our food to the table and didn’t believe that we had ordered it so he quizzed us. When we asked him for the bill he was very dismissive, said he’d get someone and never did. We ended up asking 3 separate people for our bill, hence why it took so long. The male waiter was Very stand off-ish, and honestly he was terrible at his job. The girl with the ginger and blonde hair was so nice and such a diva. This place is clearly very very understaffed, even when they have an offer on and expect an influx of customers. Our drinks normally take about 25 minutes longer than the food, so this time we ordered wine to make sure there was very little to do in order to actually serve us our drinks. Won’t be going again, food is nice but that’s about it, nothing special. Wouldn’t recommend.

negative_reviews.author: kyrell rc
negative_reviews.text:
Service was ridiculous…

The only reason we visited was because of their £5 ramen deal advertised all over social media, so we thought we’d give it a go.

The service was honestly ridiculous. My sister and I received our food, but my boyfriend and cousin were left waiting around 30 minutes for theirs. We had to tell the staff multiple times that their food hadn’t arrived, only for a waiter to ask us if we were sure nothing had come out, despite the empty spaces on the table making that pretty obvious. My sister and I had literally finished our meals by the time their food arrived.

To make matters worse, we then waited around 20 minutes for the bill. We asked two members of staff, and one of them was walking back and forth serving other tables whilst seemingly ignoring us, despite making eye contact. We eventually had to get up and approach the staff ourselves just to get the bill.

There was a complete lack of care and attention throughout the experience. The food itself was fine, but the service seriously let the whole visit down. I wouldn’t return based on this experience
